name: street-space-editor
description: Street Space Editor for OpenStreetMap — Bun workspace monorepo

scripts.type-check: bun run ensure-paraglide && bun run type-check:all
scripts.test-run: bun run ensure-paraglide && bun run test-run:all
scripts.check: bun run ensure-paraglide && bun run --parallel type-check:all lint format test-run:all
scripts.check-ci: bun run ensure-paraglide && bun run --parallel type-check:all lint-check format-check test-run:all
scripts.check-pre-push: bun run ensure-paraglide && bun run --parallel type-check:all lint format test-run:all
